Bhutan is also home to many spiritual sanctuaries, including the famous Paro Taktsang monastery, which is perched on a cliff and offers stunning views of the surrounding valley. The monastery is a great place to learn about Bhutan's unique culture and history. With its unique culture, untouched natural beauty, and spiritual sanctuaries, Bhutan is a destination that has something to offer for every kind of traveler. The best time to visit Bhutan is during the spring and autumn seasons, when the weather is mild and pleasant. The country has a unique system of tourism, which is based on the principle of high value, low impact. This means that tourists have to pay a daily tariff, which includes accommodation, food, and transportation.
